newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish May trade surplus FIM 4.59 billion -NCB.
newsitem.headline: Finnish May trade surplus FIM 4.59 billion -NCB.

text.p: Finland's trade surplus rose to 4.59 billion markka in May from 3.83 billion in April, the National Customs Board (NCB) said in a statement on Thursday.
The value of exports rose one percent year-on-year in May while the value of imports fell five percent, NCB said.
The January-May 1995 import figure was revised from 50,523 million markka and the export figure from 70,510 million markka.
The Bank of Finland earlier estimated the May trade surplus at 4.6 billion markka with exports projected at 15.5 billion and imports at 10.9 billion.
The NCB's official monthly trade statistics are lagging behind due to changes in customs procedures when Finland joined the European Union at the start of 1995.
